faq.q: What is the average temperature in Marbella in May 2028?
faq.a: In May, Marbella enjoys average highs of 26°C and lows of 18°C, with sea temperatures around 18-20°C. It's warm enough for swimming and sunbathing, but evenings can be cooler, so bring a light jacket.

faq.q: Is May a good month for a boat rental in Marbella?
faq.a: Yes, May is one of the best months. The weather is stable with plenty of sunshine, low rainfall, and calm seas. It's less crowded than June-August, making it ideal for a relaxed charter from Puerto Banús.

faq.q: What are the wind conditions like in May?
faq.a: Winds are generally light to moderate, typically 5-15 knots from the east (Levante) or west (Poniente). The coast is sheltered, so sea conditions are calm, perfect for cruising and anchoring at coves like Cala del Faro.

faq.q: How many hours of sunshine can I expect in May?
faq.a: Marbella averages about 10 hours of sunshine per day in May. The sun rises around 07:15 and sets around 21:15, giving you a long day to enjoy your boat rental.

faq.q: Will I need a jacket for a May boat trip?
faq.a: During the day, shorts and a t-shirt are fine, but evenings can drop to around 18°C. A light windbreaker or fleece is recommended for the return trip, especially if you're on a flybridge like the Azimut 58.

faq.q: What is the sea temperature in Marbella in May?
faq.a: The sea temperature is around 18-20°C in May. While invigorating, it's comfortable for swimming, especially on sunny afternoons. If you're sensitive to cold, consider a thin wetsuit.

faq.q: How far in advance should I book a boat in May?
faq.a: May is pre-peak, but weekends and the last two weeks can fill up quickly. We recommend booking at least 2-4 weeks ahead to secure your preferred boat, such as the Mangusta 80 or Astondoa 40.

faq.q: What are the best destinations for a May boat trip from Marbella?
faq.a: Popular routes include sailing west to Estepona or east to Cabopino. Cala Cortés and Cala del Faro offer sheltered anchorages. For a longer trip, head to Sotogrande or the Costa del Sol's quieter coves.

data.body_html:
Planning a marbella boat rental weather may 2028 trip? May offers near-perfect conditions: warm air, mild seas, and long sunny days. With average highs of 26°C and sea temperatures reaching 20°C, it's an ideal month for chartering from Puerto Banús. This guide gives you the numbers you need to plan your day on the water.

Average Weather in Marbella in May 2028

May in Marbella is a transition month from spring to summer. Expect average daily temperatures of 22°C, with highs of 26°C in the afternoon and lows of 18°C in the evening. Rainfall is minimal—only 3-4 days per month—and you'll enjoy about 10 hours of sunshine daily. Humidity is comfortable, typically 60-70%.

Sea Conditions and Water Temperature

The Mediterranean off Marbella's coast warms to 18-20°C in May. While still cooler than August's 24°C, it's pleasant for swimming after a few hours aboard. Waves are generally under 0.5m, thanks to the sheltering effect of the Sierra Blanca mountains. Winds are light: the Levante (east) brings a gentle breeze, while the Poniente (west) keeps seas flat.

Best Time of Day for a Boat Rental

For the calmest seas and best light, depart between 10:00 and 11:00 from Puerto Banús. The morning sun is warm but not scorching, and winds are lowest. Afternoon breezes pick up slightly, perfect for sailing. Return by 18:00 to avoid the cooler evening and potential late-afternoon gusts. Our Marbella boat rental fleet includes models like the Azimut 58 Flybridge (17.6m, 12 pax) for comfortable cruising.

What to Wear and Bring

Pack swimwear, a towel, sunscreen (SPF 50+), and a hat. A light jacket or fleece is useful for the return leg, especially on open boats like the Speedboat (7m, 6 pax). Sunglasses with a strap are recommended. All charters include water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, and light snacks—so no need to bring your own.

Popular May Routes from Puerto Banús

  • West to Estepona: 12 NM, 45 min. Anchor at the marina for lunch.
  • East to Cabopino: 8 NM, 30 min. Visit the dunes and Cala del Faro.
  • Cala Cortés: 5 NM, 20 min. Sheltered cove with clear water.
  • Sotogrande: 20 NM, 1h 15 min. Luxury marina and golf.

Which Boat is Best for May Weather?

For groups up to 12, the Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) or Azimut 58 Flybridge offer sun decks and shade. The Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) is a great option for smaller parties. If you want speed, the Pershing 46 (14m, 10 pax) handles May's light chop effortlessly. All boats depart from Puerto Banús with a licensed skipper.

Booking Tips for May 2028

May is pre-peak, but availability tightens from the third week onward. Book 2-4 weeks ahead for the best choice. Tier A boats (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39) cost €749 for 2 hours or €2,299 for 8 hours, including skipper, drinks, and VAT. The Mangusta 80 starts at €4,719 for 4 hours and includes a free jet ski. For other boats, rates are on request via WhatsApp.
